headline: Investor Michael Burry, known for the 'Big Short', says the market is in denial that the AI boom is ending and expects a major correction.
score_reason: Only a teaser was readable; the rest is paywalled and it is one investor's opinion, so lowered by 1.
importance_line: Investors hear a well-known sceptic repeat that AI shares could fall sharply; it is one person's view.
summary: Investor's Business Daily reports that Michael Burry, the investor famous for betting against the housing market before 2008, maintains that the AI boom will end and send the stock market into a major correction or crash, even as the S&P 500 and Nasdaq reach new highs.
